title: Mask Atelier
premise: A master-apprentice relay in an old opera house papier-mache workshop. Lu Qing and A-Tang guard the white-faced Cao Cao headdress; A-Tang and A-Lin look nearly identical except for hair ornaments; after the vermilion lacquer prop chest burns it must be avoided; oil-stained pattern book, count memory, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.

states.prime_master: A mask craftsman around forty, indigo short jacket dusted with pigment powder, right hand often gripping a wolf-hair brush, brows deeply furrowed.
states.lacquer_burn_arm: The same Lu Qing: right arm wrapped in white cloth burned by raw lacquer, brush switched to the left hand, jacket cuff charred black.
states.eyes_closed_dead: Lu Qing has closed his eyes in death, lying still on the workshop wooden couch, indigo short jacket covering his chest.

states.young_apprentice: A fifteen-year-old apprentice girl with twin topknots, a vermilion bib apron, vermilion paint on her fingertips, keen eyes.
states.adult_master: A woman master in her early twenties, still wearing the vermilion apron, hair in a neat bun, steady gaze.

states.intact: A freshly papier-mached white-faced Cao Cao headdress, silk beard black and neat, gold leaf on the crest still unworn.
states.lacquer_cracked: The same white-faced Cao Cao headdress: white face cracked open to hemp cloth core, beard tangled, gold leaf peeling.
states.rebacked: The white-faced Cao Cao headdress after rebacking: white face smooth, beard re-combed, gold leaf patched but slightly paler.

states.intact: A thread-bound face-pattern model book, vermilion and ink sketching painted-face formulas on xuan paper, cover stamped with a 'Lu's' vermilion seal.
states.oil_stained_pages: The same face-pattern model book soaked through with tung oil, cover sticky, formulas bled into a blur.

states.intact: A large vermilion lacquer prop chest, twin-dragon relief on the lid, copper lock gleaming, blue cloth lining.
states.burned: The vermilion prop chest scorched by fire, lid collapsed, twin-dragon relief charred and incomplete.

states.young_rival: A youth whose face closely resembles A-Tang's, but with a peacock-plume hairpin worn askew and an ink-blue apron, swaggering expression.
states.disguised_anew: A-Lin after a makeover still wears the peacock plume askew; a greasepaint scar on the temple, expression deeper.

E7.name: papier-mache atelier
E7.appearance: A street-front papier-mache atelier; half-dry mask shells dry on wooden racks, unpainted white blanks hang on the wall.

E8.name: stage side chamber
E8.appearance: An old opera house side chamber; half a red carpet runs to the stage lip, greasepaint dishes piled by the makeup mirror.

E9.name: headdress storeroom
E9.appearance: A narrow headdress storeroom; wooden racks packed with beards and velvet pompons of every color, dust drifting in light shafts.

E10.name: abandoned opera house
E10.appearance: The abandoned opera house main hall; a corner of roof tiles collapsed, half a table drape still on the empty stage.

E11.name: Lu's wooden plaque
E11.appearance: A black-lacquer wooden plaque hung on the atelier lintel, gilt letters 'Lu's Headdresses', paint chipped at the corners.

E12.name: cinnabar dishes
E12.appearance: Three celadon cinnabar dishes with undried vermilion in the wells, set on the atelier windowsill.

E13.name: indigo-cloth prop box
E13.appearance: An indigo-cloth-covered prop box with no twin-dragon relief, utterly unlike the vermilion prop chest.

E14.name: Troupe master Old Xue
E14.appearance: A lean troupe master also in an indigo short jacket, but with an ivory name-plaque on his chest; build close to Lu Qing's.

E15.name: tung-oil lamps
E15.appearance: A row of five tung-oil iron lamps hanging under the papier-mache atelier beam, shades yellowed by soot.

E16.name: copper clappers
E16.appearance: Two pairs of copper clappers hanging by the door, faces carved with key patterns, lightly knocking when wind passes.

E17.name: Xiao Ju
E17.appearance: A girl from the neighboring embroidery shop in a pale-pink apron; at a glance she resembles young A-Tang, but wears a single braid and shy eyes.

E18.name: replica white-faced helmet
E18.appearance: A half-finished replica white-faced helmet, shaped like the Cao Cao headdress but without a beard, gold leaf replaced by yellow paper.

E19.name: bamboo opera basket
E19.appearance: A bamboo-woven opera basket holding water sleeves rather than headdresses—nothing like the vermilion prop chest.

features.E2: A-Tang: vermilion bib apron, twin topknots.
features.E6: A-Lin: face nearly identical to A-Tang's, but peacock plume askew and ink-blue apron.

lookalike_pairs.note: Apprentice misidentification: apron color and hair ornament are binding cues.

scenes.setting: Papier-mache atelier at dusk (introduce five tung-oil lamps and two pairs of clappers)
actions: At dusk, mask craftsman Lu Qing pushes open the papier-mache atelier wooden door, both hands cradling the freshly papier-mached white-faced Cao Cao headdress.

actions.action: A row of five tung-oil lamps hangs under the papier-mache atelier beam; Lu Qing wipes soot from each with a cloth.
Two pairs of copper clappers hang by the door; Lu Qing brushes them and they ring clear and bright.

actions: Lu Qing sets the white-faced Cao Cao headdress on a wooden stand and combs the silk beard smooth with a bamboo comb.
Lu Qing rests against the mask-shell drying rack; tung-oil lamplight falls on his indigo short jacket.
Lu Qing opens the thread-bound face-pattern model book and checks it against the headdress formula.
He uses a vermilion brush to fill in painted-face brow lines and eye-socket finishes in the blank margins.
Lu Qing closes the model book and moves the white-faced Cao Cao headdress under a dust cover.

scenes.setting: Stage greeting the apprentice (introduce cinnabar dishes)
actions: In the morning stage side chamber, Lu Qing greets young A-Tang dragging in the vermilion lacquer prop chest.

actions.action: A-Tang opens the vermilion lacquer prop chest and takes out still-wet greasepaint dishes.
Lu Qing points to the three cinnabar dishes on the windowsill and teaches A-Tang to judge thick from thin.
A-Tang squats by the side-chamber red carpet and curiously touches the twin-dragon relief on the prop chest.

actions: In the headdress storeroom, A-Lin with the peacock plume askew turns from behind a wooden rack.
A-Lin parts a row of beards with fingertips; the ink-blue apron picks up dust.
A-Lin carries an empty greasepaint bucket through the far end of the headdress storeroom.
In the stage side chamber, A-Tang and A-Lin brush past each other—one in a vermilion apron, one with a peacock plume askew.
A-Tang shields the white blank in her arms; A-Lin flicks the peacock plume and skirts the mirror stand.
They part before the makeup mirror and walk opposite ways.
Months later on a rainy night, Lu Qing keeps watch alone in the papier-mache atelier, the white-faced Cao Cao headdress on his knees.

actions.action: Lu Qing opens the face-pattern model book; the cover is soaked through with tung oil, formulas blurred into a paste.

actions: Lu Qing carefully wipes oil flecks from the headdress gold-leaf edge, expression grave.
The opera season stretches long; day after day Lu Qing mixes white powder, brushes base lacquer, and waits for hemp cores to dry in the shade.
Another snowy night, he tightens his indigo short jacket and trims tangled beards beside the tung-oil lamp.
At opening season, Lu Qing stands by the door tallying headdress loads carried out.
At high-summer noon he fans half-dry mask shells slowly with a fine fan.
Autumn rain falls on end; the atelier smells of tung oil, cinnabar, and damp xuan paper.
Another New Year's Eve, Lu Qing lines beards on wooden racks and keeps vigil alone in the atelier till dawn.

scenes.setting: Side-chamber rounds (indigo-cloth prop box false friend)
actions: At dawn Lu Qing patrols along the stage side chamber; the vermilion lacquer prop chest leans by the mirror.

actions.action: Lu Qing crouches to check whether the prop chest copper lock is fully bitten shut.
Lu Qing rearranges scattered greasepaint dishes by black, white, and vermilion.
An indigo-cloth prop box is carried into the side chamber—no twin-dragon relief, not the vermilion lacquer prop chest.

scenes.setting: Night fire catastrophe (headdress cracks · prop chest burns)
actions: Fire breaks at midnight; thick smoke fills the papier-mache atelier, drying racks creaking in the heat.

actions.action: In the glare of flame, the white face lacquer of the white-faced Cao Cao headdress cracks open, exposing the hemp cloth core.
In the side chamber, fire tongues lick the lid of the vermilion lacquer prop chest; the copper lock darkens with heat.
The vermilion lacquer prop chest finally burns and collapses; the twin-dragon relief is charred and incomplete.
Lu Qing lunges for the cracked white-faced Cao Cao headdress and clutches it hard against his chest.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (prop chest indirect reference · tung-oil lamps long-range)

actions.action: The day after the fire, Lu Qing stands in the papier-mache atelier, left hand lifting the cracked white-faced Cao Cao headdress.
On a blank page of the face-pattern model book Lu Qing sketches the burned-through chest lock and notes the date the vermilion lacquer prop chest burned.
Half a copper lock from the vermilion lacquer prop chest hangs by the wall; Lu Qing wraps the still-blackened bolt in cloth.
He takes down one of the five tung-oil lamps from the beam and sits alone by its faint light.
At the end of the prop inventory Lu Qing adds the costumes once packed in the vermilion lacquer prop chest; the brush tip trembles slightly.

scenes.setting: Rebacking the headdress (third state · replica white-faced helmet false friend)

actions.action: Weeks later, Lu Qing scrapes away the cracked lacquer layer and begins rebacking the white-faced Cao Cao headdress.
He takes out a replica white-faced helmet to check the shape—it looks like the true headdress but has no beard, and the gold leaf is only yellow paper.
After the new hemp core is pressed flat and powdered again, the white-faced Cao Cao headdress is usable once more, gold leaf slightly paler.

actions: Lu Qing divides the rebacked beard into three neat locks with a bamboo comb.

scenes.setting: False friends: bamboo opera basket and troupe master Old Xue

actions.action: A bamboo opera basket is carried into the stage side chamber packed with water sleeves—nothing to do with the burned vermilion lacquer prop chest.
Troupe master Old Xue enters the side chamber and talks beside Lu Qing; both wear indigo short jackets.
Old Xue points at the bamboo opera basket and asks for a separate water-sleeve rack; Lu Qing notes the size in the model-book margin.

scenes.setting: False friend: Xiao Ju who resembles A-Tang

actions.action: From the next street comes Xiao Ju in a pale-pink apron; at a glance she somewhat resembles young A-Tang.
Xiao Ju tries to tidy a beard, but Lu Qing shakes his head—she wears a single braid; she is not A-Tang after all.
Years later at dusk, Lu Qing with his right arm wrapped in white cloth stands under the empty stage of the abandoned opera house.
Those two pairs of copper clappers by the abandoned opera house door knock lightly in the wind; Lu Qing stops to listen.

actions: Lu Qing presses his left palm to the cold stone pillar, as if saying goodbye.

actions.action: By day, adult A-Tang returns along the alley and hurries toward the abandoned opera house.

actions: Under the empty stage A-Tang reunites with arms-folded Lu Qing; they embrace.

actions.action: Beside the opera-house wooden couch, A-Tang holds Lu Qing's withered hand.
Lu Qing's breath fades; at last he closes his eyes and dies with eyes shut.
Behind the atelier door Lu Qing's old indigo short jacket still hangs; A-Tang brushes pigment powder from the cuff.
Under the lintel, adult A-Tang straightens the tilted Lu's wooden plaque.
A-Tang polishes the four gilt letters 'Lu's Headdresses' with a fine cloth.
A-Lin after a makeover arrives from outside the opera house and locks eyes with A-Tang under the empty stage.

actions: A-Tang and A-Lin stand side by side in the abandoned opera house—one calm, one sombre.

scenes.setting: Gongs of the past (temporal anchors · name-free)

actions.action: The gongs and drums soften; the youth who once touched the twin-dragon relief by the side-chamber red carpet reappears.

anchor.phrase: the youth who touched the twin-dragon relief by the side-chamber red carpet

actions.action: Lamplight returns to the papier-mache atelier; a white-faced headdress is set firmly on a wooden stand for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the white-faced headdress first set on a wooden stand at the opening

actions.action: Dust rises again in the headdress storeroom; the figure with peacock plume askew and ink-blue apron passes the wooden racks.

anchor.phrase: the figure with peacock plume askew in the storeroom that year

actions.action: That row of five tung-oil iron lamps under the atelier beam lights one by one in the dark.

anchor.phrase: that row of five tung-oil iron lamps under the atelier beam

actions.action: The side chamber with the makeup mirror from first meeting unfolds again; the half-rolled red carpet stops at the stage lip.

anchor.phrase: the side chamber with the makeup mirror from first meeting

scenes.setting: Closing (model book long-range · cinnabar dishes long-range)

actions.action: A-Tang carries the oil-stained face-pattern model book into the papier-mache atelier.
Those five tung-oil lamps under the atelier beam still burn; A-Tang checks them one by one along the posts.
On the windowsill, those earlier three cinnabar dishes still sit ranked by thickness.
A-Tang lifts the rebacked white-faced Cao Cao headdress and dips cinnabar to start the brush anew.
